topology_note: R1 Gi0/0.20 is the VLAN 20 gateway. VLAN 20 uses 10.10.20.0/24. About 30 PCs are in this VLAN.
expected_fault: R1's Gi0/0.20 subinterface is configured with a /28 subnet mask (255.255.255.240) instead of /24 (255.255.255.0), so only hosts in the 10.10.20.0-10.10.20.15 range are considered local; hosts above .15 are unreachable from the gateway.
